scope: Static registry declared by MirAIe Android 01.4.32, not a device support or wire-command guarantee.

provenance.extraction: Tracked const-string, const-class, integer constants and move-object register assignments for each exact five-argument enum constructor; all constructor records covered, unique identifiers asserted.

warnings: identifier is the Java enum identifier; capability is the model capability-name string; neither is the model-specific wire attribute key.
ki is a registry constructor argument, not enum ordinal or array position.
Names and ki values can collide; resolve with actual model, capability class, transport and native command builder.
A registry entry may describe status/config metadata, not a writable actuator.
No non-AC entry has been live verified in this project.
